 Print BSEB exam registration 2027 date extended The Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has issued dummy admit cards for students appearing in the Class 10 (Matric) and Class 12 (Intermediate) annual examinations in 2027. Students can download their dummy hall tickets from the board's official website between November 1 and November 7, 2026. The board has advised students to check all the particulars printed on their dummy admit cards carefully. The exercise is intended to help candidates identify errors in their personal, academic, and examination-related details before the final admit cards are issued. Students who find discrepancies in their dummy hall tickets must report them to the heads of their respective schools or educational institutions within the prescribed correction window. The necessary corrections will be submitted online through the institutions. BSEB dummy admit card 2027 : Official websites
 The dummy admit cards have been prepared using the details furnished by students in their registration and examination application forms. Candidates can access their respective hall tickets through the following portals: Class 10 (Matric): exam.biharboardonline.org
 Class 12 (Intermediate): intermediate.biharboardonline.com
 Students should download the document and verify every entry instead of relying only on the information displayed during registration. BSEB dummy admit card 2027: Correction window and important instructions
 The correction facility will remain available from November 1 to November 7, 2026. Candidates who notice incorrect information must immediately contact their school authorities and request the required changes. The board has also specified restrictions on corrections. A complete change in the student's own name or the names of their parents will not be permitted. Students should therefore examine these particulars carefully and report any other eligible discrepancy to their respective institutions within the deadline. Candidates should not wait until the last day to approach their school authorities, as corrections have to be processed online within the stipulated period. BSEB Class 10, 12 dummy admit card 2027: Steps to download hall ticket
 Students can follow the steps elucidated here to access the BSEB Class 10th, 12th hall tickets 2026 from the official website: Visit the official BSEB website for the respective examination: exam.biharboardonline.org for Matric or intermediate.biharboardonline.com for Intermediate.
 Look for the dummy admit card link on the homepage.
 Click on the relevant link.
 Enter the required login credentials.
 Click on the Submit button.
 The BSEB dummy admit card will appear on the screen.
 Download the document and take a printout for verification.
 Check all the details and report eligible discrepancies to the head of the institution.
 Candidates should retain a copy of the downloaded dummy admit card for reference during the correction process. BSEB dummy admit card 2027: Details to check
 Students must carefully verify the following particulars printed on their dummy hall tickets: Student's name
 Roll number
 Registration number
 Date of birth
 Father's name
 Mother's name
 School name and code
 Examination name
 Class and examination category
 Photograph
 Signature
 Subject names and codes
 Examination centre details
 Other personal and examination-related information
 Any discrepancy in the permitted fields should be brought to the notice of the school authorities within the correction period. Incorrect subject details, registration information or other particulars could create complications during subsequent examination-related processes if left unaddressed. BSEB Class 10, 12 board exams 2027 expected in February
 The BSEB is expected to conduct the Class 10 and Class 12 annual examinations in February 2027. However, the board has not yet released the official examination timetable for either class. Students should continue preparing according to their respective syllabuses and keep checking the official BSEB websites for updates on the examination schedule, final admit cards and other announcements. The issuance of dummy admit cards is an important verification exercise ahead of the annual examinations. Candidates should complete the scrutiny of their details and report eligible corrections before November 7 to avoid last-minute complications.
